note: Moi dong (lot) = 1 SKU trong 1 lo hang nhap (Inbound, vd JHQ326-03) lay tu Notion Reorder Tracker qua Notion connector (SQL mode; formula/rollup cua Notion khong tra ve nen duoc tinh lai trong build_lots.py). landed = gia von landed/unit USD = EXW + Shipping Cost/Unit + Unit Duties & Taxes (chua gom phi FBA/ShipMonk); Shipping Cost/Unit = tong payment logistics cua shipment (tru Duties & Taxes) chia theo the tich (Qty x CBM) cua tung dong; Unit Duties & Taxes = EXW x thue suat (Actual Tariff Rate, neu trong thi lay Product Tariff cua Restock Item hoac Tariff rate cua Product Group). Cong thuc da doi chieu khop 32/32 dong sheet nhapT9. landed = null khi chua gan shipment, shipment chua co payment logistics, hoac SKU chua co CBM. dest = kho lo hang di toi (FBA / Shipmonk NV3 / PA2 / TO1 / SAT ...), ata = ngay hang den that (ETA khi chua den). Khi xuat kho FIFO: dung received_qty neu > 0, nguoc lai dung qty; sap xep lo theo ata (roi eta, roi created). SKU trong (chua gan Restock Item) van nam trong lots nhung khong co trong by_sku.
